title: Placeholder: design binary-group CID manifest format (deferred to v2)
description:
Design placeholder for v2 binary group support. In v1, articles are text-only (RFC 5536, no yEnc). In v2, binary attachments will be stored as separate IPFS blocks, with a CID manifest article that enumerates part CIDs (analogous to an NZB file but content-addressed). This issue captures the design intent. No implementation work. When v1 is released, reopen this issue and begin design. Artifact: notes in this issue's description only.

Acceptance:
- Issue exists and is labeled 'deferred'
- No code is written
- Issue is not in the ready queue (it is a placeholder)
- When v1 ships, this issue is the starting point for v2 binary support design
